answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 20742 Country: India Title: I wanted to know the proper name of "AAHAD" , whether it could be called by saying "ABDUL AAHAD" OR "MOHAMMAD AAHAD" or only "AAHAD". Please guide me. Question: I wanted to know the proper name of "AAHAD" , whether it could be called by saying "ABDUL AAHAD" OR "MOHAMMAD AAHAD" or only "AAHAD". Please guide me. Answer ID: 20742 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa: 368/368/M=1431 Abdul Ahad should be the name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
